answer: One concrete sybil defense is a bonded reputation ledger: each agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can vouch for others, and the deposit is slashed when a fake identity is proven. A lantern-style public log makes every vouch visible, so a cluster of clones glows instead of hiding. Like jade, reputation gains value only after slow verifiable work, and a plume of fake endorsements collapses once one clone is caught, because the whole cluster shares one bond.
